name: inverse_goldmine_stocks
description: Inverse of all goldmine_stocks consensus tiers (goldmine_1x_consensus through goldmine_5x_consensus). Parent has 21.2% WR (18W/67L) and PF 0.38 on n=85 closed equity trades. 71.8% of exits are sl_hit (61/85), with only 21.2% tp_hit (18/85). Goldmine consensus is consistently picking equities that fall — fading the consensus (SHORT what goldmine longs) should symmetrically capture the 78.8% downside outcomes. Per TESTING_PROTOCOL.md §7 + STRATEGY_INVESTIGATION_BEFORE_KILL.md §3 mutation-before-kill rule. Exposed by 2026-04-14 forward-tracking fix in audit_trail/dashboard_generator.py (PR #207) which revealed goldmine's true performance after the loader bug was patched.

config._size_note: Half-size during forward validation per STRATEGY_INVESTIGATION_BEFORE_KILL.md §4 (small position until n>=20 confirms inverse symmetry)

promotion_criteria._note: Promotion to wired_in_scanner=true requires forward results meeting ALL criteria. If wr<60% on n>=20, retire (inverse hypothesis falsified). If wr 50-60%, hold for n=50 confirmation.

kill_criteria._note: Per STRATEGY_INVESTIGATION_BEFORE_KILL.md §5: kill if forward wr<40% on n>=20 (inverse failed AND parent failed = symmetrically dead, meaning random direction). At that point goldmine_stocks should be added to BLOCKED_SOURCE_SYSTEMS instead.
